packet.title: Query AST and parser seam (design) — Early

body.p: After . Owns src/xpath_ast_internal.h, src/xpath_ast.c, src/xpath_parse.c, tests/xpath_ast_test.c. One kind per visible production of grammars/xquery () added to the AST ( conventions); the CST walker of xpath_parse.c dispatches XQuery node types to a parser part (3.2) the way lowering parts work. IR for five XQuery examples written out in comments (FLWOR with group by, a window clause, a direct constructor with namespaces, try/catch with finally, a prolog function). Done when every XP40 query still builds the same AST. Done 2026-10-17 (): XQuery kinds, fields, details and flags and five examples in src/xpath_ast_internal.h; sxml_ast_build_with_parser_part in src/xpath_parse.c, seam tests in tests/xpath_ast_test.c. 3.2 adds sxml_grammar_xquery to the sxml link line of CMakeLists.txt.
